_doc: WT64v1 single machine-readable ISA source (v1.8.0a COMMIT 1, spec §23.9). Edit THIS file, run scripts/gen_isa_tables.py generate, commit source + generated artifacts together. asm_legality and rtl_legality are DELIBERATELY separate: two documented asymmetries are preserved emitter-faithfully (asm skips required-port under allow_imm_xor_opref; asm fine-grained imm forbids vs RTL collapsed forbid_imm_any; RTL is_alu_binary excludes 0x63/64/65). Unification is an explicit v1.8.0b decision — do not silently "fix" one emitter.

opcodes.notes: v1.6.5c §22.16.0 bugfix preserved: IMM64/OPREF EHs are LEGAL here even though the RTL data path reads only input_payload_b — the EH carries the SDK static-schedule origin. RTL is_alu_binary EXCLUDES 0x63/64/65 (no XOR check) while asm enforces imm64-XOR-opref: documented asymmetry, asm-legal is a subset of RTL-legal.
PRECISION EH (dim_ovr) expected for tag-stability (§22.16.3) — precision is not a data EH, so forbid flags do not affect it.
unary no-B shape — NOT the ALU-binary shape 0x6B uses (corrected from an earlier draft).

opcodes.desc: int4/int8 lanes x broadcast B, int32 accumulate (v1.8 WIDE-ACC; fp dtypes are v2.0 loosening)
opcodes.notes: v1.8.0a COMMIT 2 stub: decode-legal, PE_Core raises lower_required (capability absence, not malformation). Mode-byte legality per the normative spec §23.6a table — restrictive-first, later loosening only. v1.8.0b: stays stub — deferred to v1.8.0c (stateless form needs 16-fragment output FSM; stateful form needs the accumulator design; both remain open). SDK covers dot-shaped uses via VDOT chains.

opcodes.desc: VDOT_ACC — stateless 4-fragment wide dot: A=wide[127:0], B=wide[255:128] (SIG_BMM_3 pattern); dtype 0x0=32 int4 lanes, 0x1=16 int8 lanes; r=(sext64(dot)+carry_in) mod 2^64 emitted immediately (full 64-bit payload); carry-in via IMM-XOR-OPREF (asm default IMM16=0); MU-hosted (twin classifier)
opcodes.notes: v1.8.0b IMPLEMENTED (stateless-dot-first, workflow wwov1b5i3). NO accumulator state — K-loops chain via serial carry-in or VDOT partials + ADD 0x10 trees; low-32 of any chain == numpy int32 wrap (IMMA channel). SDK contract: exactly 4 fragments, instruction+EH chain replicated on every fragment.

opcodes.desc: ACC_REDUCE — stateless reduction over wide[127:0]: sub-op imm16[7:4] per acc_reduce_op_codes (absent imm16 = SUM); imm16[3:0] reserved-zero else lower_required; MEAN=RNE(sum/N) ties-to-even, full lane set only; emits sext64(int32); MU-hosted
opcodes.notes: v1.8.0b IMPLEMENTED. Monotonic loosening: imm16 forbidden->optional (absent=SUM keeps every previously-legal encoding decoding). MIN deliberately NOT shipped (RED=2 vs einsum=6 namespace collision dodged). imm32/imm64 stay asm-forbidden but are RTL-tolerated (eff_imm16=0 => SUM) — documented reserved.

opcodes.notes: v1.8.0b IMPLEMENTED (scalar form). Monotonic loosenings: mem required->optional (present = offset IGNORED in 0b, RESERVED for the v1.8.0d memory-destination store form — asm warns), imm16 forbidden->optional. imm16[15:6] reserved-zero else lower_required. Never asserts memory_req in 0b.

fp_block._doc: 0x70-0x7F mode-byte legality — transcription of the NORMATIVE spec §23.6a table (COMMIT 0, independently reviewed). dtype=eff_precision[3:0], acc=[5:4], rnd=[7:6]; semantics active ONLY inside this block (in_fp_block self-gate). Global invariants (hand-pinned in tests, generator-independent): dtype 0x5 = f64/Lf-reserved illegal everywhere; dtype>0x7 illegal; rnd!=0 illegal in v1.8.0a (SR=1 is a v2.0 loosening at STORE_QUANT); acc!=1 illegal in v1.8.0a (bf16+acc0 permanently).
